relations.subject: Hans Georg Conon von der Gabelentz
relations.evidence: Son of —> H. C. von der Gabelentz (1807–1874) and Henriette von Linsingen.

relations.subject: Hans Georg Conon von der Gabelentz
relations.evidence: After gymnasium in Altenburg studied law at Jena (or Halle, also linguistics).

relations.subject: Hans Georg Conon von der Gabelentz
relations.evidence: From 1878 ao. Professor für ostasiatische Sprachen at Leipzig, being the very first Professor of East Asian languages in Germany.

relations.subject: Hans Georg Conon von der Gabelentz
relations.evidence: From 1882 ord. honor. Professor. In 1889 he moved to Berlin

relations.subject: Hans Georg Conon von der Gabelentz
relations.evidence: In 1889 he moved to Berlin, where his official title was Professor für vergleichende Sprachwissenschaft.
